A subject, followed along the whole path

Finding your way

Home, Now, the menu, Find, Scan and the ?.

Start Before the first record

What it is · Find a part of the app on Home

Home sorts the app into groups. Each one is a stretch of the same path.

GroupWhat lives there
FarmPlots, map, field log, weather, trails, rows and plants, crop care
LotsHarvests, process runs, green lots, passports, the EUDR guide
Roast and cupRoast timer, Roastbook, graph, colour, brew log, cupping, brew guide, water
BusinessTeam and wages, field jobs, sales and money, land and dues, names lists

Seen fromRoast at a glance

Step 1

The first time, Roast opens on Home: every part of the app is one tap away from here. Across the top, on every page: KoffyKraft (back to Home), the language box, the ? and the round person button. Below them, the menu scrolls sideways.

Seen fromYour first day, step 1Getting set up

Step 2

Further down, the groups Farm, Lots, Roast and cup and Business hold a button for each part of the app.

Seen fromYour first day, step 2

What it is · Get help on the page I am on

The ? opens this manual at the part about the page you are on, on every page including Now. With no signal it opens the short guide kept inside the app. The person button opens Me: your activity on this phone, and Account and sign-in, Shared spaces and My data.

Seen fromYour first day

Step 5

Tap Show my pages. You land on Now, and the menu changes on every page: Now, then your own pages (up to seven), then All and Account. Before you answer, the menu stays as it was.

Seen fromYour first day, step 5Getting set up

What it is · Choose how many boxes the forms show

How deep? decides how many boxes a form shows. Casual shows the main boxes, Keen a few more (picking, ripeness, Brix, grade), Professional every box. A box that already holds something always shows. On any form, Show all boxes brings back the rest for that visit, and you can change your answer any time on Account.

Seen fromYour first dayGetting set up

What it is · See what is live today

Now shows what is live on this phone: plots to look at, harvests this week, runs in process, green stock and roasts resting.

Seen fromYour first day

Step 6

Tap a tile to jump to its section. Tap the dashed Tiles tile to choose which tiles Now shows, grouped from land to cup; Use my activities ticks the ones that match Make it yours.

Seen fromYour first day, step 6

Step 7 · Add something new from anywhere

The bar at the bottom stays in reach of your thumb. New adds a harvest, process run, reading, green lot, roast, brew or cup, colour reading or plot. Find opens Find. Home goes home. Scan reads a KoffyKraft QR with the camera, or from a saved photo or screenshot.

Seen fromYour first day, step 7One coffee, one chain

What it is

Each section has its own quick button, such as + New harvest, + New run, + Add green and + Start roast. My pages lists your pinned pages (Edit changes them). The Done shelf keeps finished work by coffee season (October to September) and month, so Now stays short.

Seen fromYour first day

Tip

The small i beside the word Now says how long things stay live: a run until a green lot is made from it (or 60 days pass), a roast for 30 days while it rests. If you only brew or taste, the bottom bar changes to New brew, Repeat last and Brew timer.

Seen fromYour first day

Step 8 · Find a plot, lot or code

Type in the Find box on Home or Now, or tap Find. Type part of a name or a code. Your records come first, each with its kind on the right. Tap one to open it. Under the results: Searched on this phone. Works with no signal.

Seen fromYour first day, step 8One coffee, one chain

Plot Where it grows

Step 1 · Open my estates and plots

Open Origin and the Farm tab. Your estates come first, then your plots, each with its variety, area and age. + Estate and + Plot add new ones.

Try it in the app ›

Seen fromEstates and plots, step 1

What it is

An open plot shows a short summary (variety, species, area, last harvest) and buttons that jump to each part: Location, Land check, Plants, Soil, Flowering, Plot and cup, Map, Rows and Photos. Below them, the chain: the harvests picked here, and what came of them.

Seen fromEstates and plotsOne coffee, one chain

Harvest The day's picking

Step 1 · Record today's picking

Open Origin from the menu, then the Harvest tab. A line shows the season so far (harvests, kilos of cherry, average Brix), then your harvests, newest first.

Try it in the app ›

Process run Cherry to green

Tip

On Now, New then Reading (pH, Brix, temp, photo) picks a live run and takes you to it. Each step also has its own Photo button.

Seen fromProcess runsQuality as you go

Roast Heat and time

Step 1 · Start a new roast

Open Roastbooks (from Home, under Roast and cup). New Roast sets up the coffee, then opens the timer. Timer opens it directly; Roastbook holds your finished roasts.

Try it in the app ›

Seen fromRoasting, step 1

Step 8 · Find a past roast

Open Roastbook: every finished roast, newest first. Filter by estate, coffee, date or roast type. Open a roast to see its curve, phases and chain back to the green lot.

Try it in the app ›

Seen fromRoasting, step 8

Cup Brew, cup and taste

Step 1 · Log a brew

Open Cup. The Brew tab lists your brews; tap + Brew. Brew several runs timers for several brews at once.

Try it in the app ›

Your records Copies, exports, leaving

Step 6 · See everything I have recorded

Tap the round person button on any page for Me: totals for what you have grown, processed, roasted and brewed, a chart for the last 12 months, and your recent records. Profile makes a one-page profile with your name, logo and colour; save it as PDF or publish a link.

Try it in the app ›

Seen fromYour records, step 6

Help Snags and words

What it is

I cannot find a record. Use Find (on Home or Now): it searches the records on this phone by name, code or word, with no signal needed. A voided record is still found, marked Voided. If you use more than one phone, sign in on both so they see the same records.

Seen fromWhen something goes wrong, and the words used
